'''2005 World Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed World Championship, held at Gen Con in Indianapolis, Indiana.<ref name="awards">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ Awards and Hall of Fame], starwarsccg.org; Wayback [https://web.archive.org/web/20230817222457/https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ 17 August 2023]</ref> [[Drew Scott]] defeated [[James Booker]].<ref name="awards" />

The constructed pool was printed Decipher cards through [[Theed Palace]] plus original [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Players Committee Virtual Sets]] then legal. A numbered original-VS cutoff for this event is not dested here.

Published 60s from this event are not on this wiki yet.

* '''Environment:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
